subject.facility_name: WATER'S EDGE CENTER FOR HEALTH & REHABILITATION

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $179.36 per resident day (43.7% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 4.7% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $785,861, 8.7% of the $9,021,091 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,554,266, $30.9 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $758,634 (48.8%), allocated fringe $260,204 (16.7%), non-wage costs $535,428 (34.4%). Raw food was $460,271 ($9.15 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $26,864.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $848,936, $16.88 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $586,856 (69.1%), allocated fringe $201,286 (23.7%), non-wage costs $60,794 (7.2%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $366,105, $7.28 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $52,977 (14.5%), allocated fringe $18,171 (5.0%), non-wage costs $294,957 (80.6%).
Missing data: cost years 2019, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075381/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2019 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2021 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; costs per resident day outside the plausible range; revenue per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
